oe_wp35_ming_yuelu_hall = {
	audio_tier = 5
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	in_empty = owned
	pop_type = clergy
	max_levels = 1
	employment_size = 1.0
	category = cultural_category

	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	expensive = yes
	forbidden_for_estates = yes
	can_destroy = { always = no }

	build_time = 900
	construction_demand = library_construction

	location_potential = {
		this = location:changsha
	}
	country_potential = {
		owns = location:changsha
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
	}
	allow = {
		has_owner = yes
		owner ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		}
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wp35_ming_yuelu_hall_built }
				location = { has_owner = yes }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_wp35_ming_yuelu_hall_built value = 1 }
			location.owner = {
				add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
				culture = { add_cultural_tradition = 4 }
			}
		}
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		confucian_school_maintenance
	}

	modifier = {
		local_monthly_literacy = 0.04
		local_cultural_tradition = 0.12
		local_institution_growth_modifier = 0.12
	}
}
